properties.displayName: UAV S25 - Container Resource Exhaustion DoS (CPU/Memory + Connection Burst)
properties.description: UAVResourceMetrics_CL에서 특정 컨테이너 CPU > MaxCpuUsagePct 또는 Memory > MaxMemoryUsageMb가 5분 이상 지속, 동시에 UAVDatalinkConn_CL에서 연결 폭증 탐지. MITRE: T1499 Endpoint DoS
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let cpuMax = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxCpuUsagePct'
    | project toreal(Value));
let memMax = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxMemoryUsageMb'
    | project toreal(Value));
let ResourceAlert =
    UAVResourceMetrics_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where CpuUsagePct > cpuMax or MemoryUsageMb > memMax
    | summarize MaxCpu=max(CpuUsagePct), MaxMem=max(MemoryUsageMb),
        DurationMin=datetime_diff('minute', max(TimeGenerated), min(TimeGenerated))
        by ContainerName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
    | where DurationMin >= 5
    | project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, MaxCpu, MaxMem;
let ConnBurst =
    UAVDatalinkConn_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | summarize ConnCount=count() by PeerIp, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
    | where ConnCount > 50
    | project TimeGenerated, PeerIp, ConnCount;
ResourceAlert
| join kind=leftouter (ConnBurst) on TimeGenerated
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isnotnull(ConnCount), strcat(ContainerName, "_자원고갈_연결폭증_동시_CPU:", tostring(toint(MaxCpu)), "%"),
    MaxCpu > cpuMax and MaxMem > memMax, strcat(ContainerName, "_CPU_메모리_동시_임계초과"),
    strcat(ContainerName, "_자원고갈_5분지속_CPU:", tostring(toint(MaxCpu)), "%"))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, MaxCpu, MaxMem, ConnCount, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S25 - Container Resource Exhaustion DoS (CPU/Memory + Connection Burst) - {{ContainerName}}
